outlook:
What Lennar says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: orders, deliveries and gross marginLooking ahead to the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect to generate new orders of approximately 19,500 to 20,500 homes, and to deliver approximately 22,000 to 23,000 homes with gross margin of approximately 15.5% to 16.0%. We expect our average sales price to be in the range of approximately $370,000 to $380,000 and our SG&A to improve toward 8.7% to 9.0%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 16, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
